module "MF_ToonUV.dss"

product 0 MaterialFunction "MF_ToonUV" backend=Graph
  library "MoonToon|Shared"
  desc "UV channel select, then scale and offset. ScaleOffset is xy = scale, zw = offset."
  %0 = FunctionInput(Description="Which UV channel to read.", InputName="UVChannel", InputType="Scalar", IsOptional=true, PreviewValue=(0, 0, 0, 0), SortPriority=0) : float @L11:C1 "UVChannel"
  %1 = FunctionInput(Description="xy scales the UV, zw is added afterwards.", InputName="ScaleOffset", InputType="Vector4", IsOptional=true, PreviewValue=(1, 1, 0, 0), SortPriority=1) : float4 @L11:C1 "ScaleOffset"
  %2 = FunctionCall[/MoonToon/MaterialFunctions/Utils/MF_UVChannelSwitch](UVChannelIndex=%0, FunctionPath="/MoonToon/MaterialFunctions/Utils/MF_UVChannelSwitch") : [Result:float2] @L13:C23 "Selected"
  %3 = Swizzle(%1, Mask="xy") : float2 @L14:C23
  %4 = Multiply(%2, %3) : float2 @L14:C12
  %5 = Swizzle(%1, Mask="zw") : float2 @L14:C40
  %6 = Add(%4, %5) : float2 @L14:C12
  %7 = FunctionOutput(%6, OutputName="Result", SortPriority=0) @L11:C1 "Result"
  inputs %0, %1
  outputs %7
